text:
Anya: Quick pre-launch sync — final readiness check for Marketplace listing + SI demo lanes. Press embargo set for Tue 03/30 11:00 PT. Can owners confirm readiness by EOD today? @Sasha (Legal) @Liam (SI)
Jamal: On marketing assets — landing hero + 2 screenshots done. CTA copy looks good. Staging link: https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace :thumbsup:
Priya: Blog draft is up, awaiting one legal paragraph from Sasha. I can push updates to PR by 4pm.
Sasha (Legal): I need the final partner quote from the HW partner (missing). I pinged their comms lead this morning.
Liam (SI): Demo checklist ✅. Need SKU mapping and a single test tenant from infra. Can Tom share?
Tom: SKU mapping attached in drive. Infra confirms staging cutover script ready. Will start canary sequence 30m before press.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled at `2026-03-30T09:45:00Z`, rollback window 15m. Triggered by @Tom.
Anya: Two open items: partner quote (Sasha) and SI attendee list (Liam). If both done by 5pm PT, I will green-light press ops for embargo release at 11am PT tomorrow.
Jamal: Press list confirmed: TechCrunch, VentureBeat, The Register. I’ll assemble press notes and send to press-ops channel once legal clears.
Priya: Also need final hero alt text for accessibility. @Jamal can you loop design?
Tom: Infra note — staging cutover slot at 03:30 PT, DB migration limited to 5m, monitoring hooked to the logs stream. Quick tail: `curl -s https://logs.redwood.ai/stream/marketplace | jq .level,.msg`
Liam (SI): SI attendees: Liam, Neha, Carlos. Demo order: onboarding -> scale test -> failure recovery. I'll drop the runbook in the drive.
Sasha (Legal): Received partner quote from HW partner just now, reviewed and cleared. :white_check_mark:
Anya: Excellent. If no blocks by 5pm PT, I will notify press ops and start the embargo countdown. Reply here with any blockers.
Tom: I'll be on standby during rollout and monitor metrics.
Jamal: Preparing one-liner for CEO and quick FAQ for press kit.
Priya: Blog PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/432 — ready for review, pending Sasha's line.
Anya: /remind #partnerships to check status at 17:00 PT today
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: channel=#partnerships time=2026-03-30T17:00:00-07:00
Liam (SI): All good from SI side. Dry run at 10am PT tomorrow — see you there. :rocket:
Anya: Thanks everyone — holiday buffer noted. If anyone hits a blocker, call me directly. Good sync.
